requirements.evidence: 3-cell linear rack (piece:0,0,0;full, piece:1,0,0;full, piece:2,0,0;full) with 10x hex-acc-keyhole accessories mounted on rear-facing slots (accessory:0#0,0#1 etc.) to hang on wall screws via lift-and-drop.

requirements.requirement: With hooks for small hand tools
requirements.evidence: 5x hex-acc-hook accessories on forward-facing slots (accessory:0#0,0#2, accessory:0#0,0#5, accessory:0#2,0#2, accessory:0#2,0#4, accessory:0#2,0#5) providing hanging points for tools; joints locked with jointBolts and open faces capped.

finish.summary: Built 3-cell linear wall rack with 10 keyhole hangers on rear for wall mounting and 5 hook plates on front for small hand tools. House rules applied (capOpenFaces, lockJoints), meshClash clear.

lines.label: M6 x 20 socket head screw, ISO 4762
M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
